summary: Iteration 5: Verified the backend-URL fix (preview -> production default) and the Android device -> Consola ao Vivo flow on preview. Static checks: workflow YAML is valid, env CONEX_BACKEND_URL = vars.CONEX_BACKEND_URL || 'https://conex-assist-2.emergentagent.host'; build.gradle.kts default backendUrl and the csproj ConexBackendUrl default are the same production URL, and no preview URL is left in android/, windows/ or .github/. Production (read only, nothing written): /api/health returned 200 {ok:true}; the /api/socket.io polling handshake returned an engine.io '0{sid,...}' packet. Preview: an emulated Android device (register platform android, path /api/socket.io, auth {token, kind:'device'}, support:request {consent_screen:true, screen:'1080x2400', link_code:''}) passed over both the websocket transport (the Android app tries it first) and polling. The admin socket got support:request, the session showed up in GET /sessions?status=pending, take+accept worked, the device got support:assigned, session:started and webrtc:request-offer, and the session stored resolution 1080x2400 with consent.screen true. UI: logged in as test_admin; in Consola ao Vivo the new console-device-<id> appeared live without a reload about 1s after the request, header NOVOS went 1->2 and ONLINE 1->2, and the 'Novo pedido de assistência' toast showed. take-btn -> console-accept-btn turned the session 'Em curso' and NOVOS went back to 1. The device got session:started + webrtc:request-offer, and console-end-btn ended the session. The user's real emulator session 842494e9 was not touched.
action_items: Tell the user to check that GitHub repo variable CONEX_BACKEND_URL (Settings > Variables) is NOT set to the preview URL: vars.CONEX_BACKEND_URL takes precedence over the new production default.
The user must rebuild and reinstall the APK and Windows app; the old APK still points to preview and will keep showing 'A aguardar técnico…' with no device on the production CRM.
critical_code_review_comments: build.gradle.kts: System.getenv('CONEX_BACKEND_URL') ?: ... does not handle an EMPTY env var (getenv returns "" and not null), so BACKEND_URL would be "". Use ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } for safety. The workflow cannot currently produce an empty value, so this is low risk.
Suggestion: show the backend host (BuildConfig.BACKEND_URL) on a small 'Sobre'/diagnostic line in the Android and Windows apps, so a wrong-environment build is easy to spot next time.
